CardDescription.DefaultText:
Its wood is low weight and easy to work, but of low quality. It can also be fired in a Kiln to make tar.

Should produce pinecones during autumn and resin from cuts on its trunk.
CardDescription.Text: 松树木材重量轻且易于加工，但品质较低。也可以在窑中燃烧以制造焦油。\n\n秋季会产生松果，并且在树干上的切口处会分泌松脂。
CardDescription.zh: 松树木材重量轻且易于加工，但品质较低。也可以在窑中燃烧以制造焦油。\n\n秋季会产生松果，并且在树干上的切口处会分泌松脂。
CardDescription.en: Its wood is low weight and easy to work, but of low quality. It can also be fired in a Kiln to make tar.\n\nShould produce pinecones during autumn and resin from cuts on its trunk.
CardDescription.ja: その木材は軽く、扱いやすいがクオリティが低い。窯に入れたらタールを作れる。\n\n秋になると松ぼっくりが取れる。幹を切ると樹脂が出る。
